output.summary: The original request from SH-CS (CL-01/CL-03) was to build an AI assistant drafting apology replies to double-charged customers. Investigation (problem PD-1) instead established the real root cause: on 2026-09-09, payments engineering (SH-PAY) disabled idempotency-key enforcement on the gateway via change CHG-77 to debug capture latency and never rolled it back (E-01); because gateway timeout retries continued at the same stable rate as before, the PSP began executing those retries as new duplicate charges instead of deduplicating them (E-02, E-03), driving a 27x surge in double-charge tickets (E-04). This is captured in hypothesis H-GATEWAY-IDEMPOTENCY-DISABLED (CONFIRMED), while the apology-tooling framing was rejected (H-APOLOGY-TOOLING-SUFFICIENT REJECTED, contradicted by E-01 through E-05). The release decision is RELEASE_WITH_KNOWN_LIMITATION with no holds: the read-only verification/monitoring work (verify_psp_capture_dedup:DA-PSP, monitor_ticket_volume:DA-TKT, confirm_config_change_recorded:DA-CFG) is released, consistent with the DEFINE gate's CONDITIONAL_PASS. The actual remediation action (set_capture_idempotency on gateway-config, which requires SH-OPS runtime approval per constraint K-GW and runbook E-07) and refund reconciliation for the 242 already-affected orders (E-03) remain outside the released scope, each blocked by an open verification obligation (VOB-R-2 and VOB-U-AFFECTED-CUSTOMERS-REFUND).
key_points: Root cause: config audit log shows CHG-77 disabled idempotency_key_enforcement on 2026-09-09 and it was never rolled back (E-01, fact F-01).
Charge ledger shows duplicate captures jumped from 0 on 09-07/09-08 to 118 and 124 on 09-09/09-10 while gateway timeout retries stayed flat at 117-124/day throughout (E-02, F-02).

PSP's independent capture log confirms 0 duplicate orders pre-change (238/238 retries carried idempotency keys, deduplicated) versus 242 duplicate orders post-change (242/242 missing keys), ruling out client-side duplicate submission or ledger double-counting (E-03, F-03).
Double-charge support tickets rose roughly 27x, from 9-11/week to 288-301/week, with order volume flat, timed to the config change (E-04, F-04).

Stakeholder SH-PAY corroborates the mechanism and notes re-enabling enforcement is a one-setting change requiring payments-operations runtime confirmation (E-05), grounded in runbook requirement E-07/F-05/F-06 under constraint K-GW.
The originally requested apology-drafting assistant (CL-01/CL-03) was rejected as a fix because it does not address the gateway/idempotency mechanism shown in E-01 through E-05.

Released scope covers verification and monitoring only (verify_psp_capture_dedup:DA-PSP, monitor_ticket_volume:DA-TKT, confirm_config_change_recorded:DA-CFG); the protected action set_capture_idempotency itself was not executed in this release.
DEFINE gate returned CONDITIONAL_PASS with the refund-affected-customers unknown deferred to VOB-U-AFFECTED-CUSTOMERS-REFUND.
limitations_explained: The DEFINE gate only reached CONDITIONAL_PASS; some open questions were deferred as verification obligations (VOBs) rather than resolved before this release.

VOB-U-AFFECTED-CUSTOMERS-REFUND is still open and sits outside this release's scope, so nothing in this release addresses refunding the 242 customers already duplicate-charged in 2026-09-09..10 (E-03).
VOB-R-2 is still open and outside release scope: it is unknown whether the gateway-config tool is actually reachable/healthy, so the fix action set_capture_idempotency has not been executed yet.

VOB-R-3 (non-critical, overlapping release scope) asks whether re-enabling idempotency-key enforcement could reintroduce the original capture-latency problem that motivated CHG-77; this remains unresolved.
No process control yet exists to require 'temporary' gateway changes like CHG-77 to carry a mandatory rollback deadline, so a similar disablement could persist unnoticed again.

Completeness of DA-CHG, DA-PSP and DA-TKT is UNKNOWN, so refund reconciliation (verify_duplicate_capture_resolution:DA-CHG) was excluded pending VOB-U-AFFECTED-CUSTOMERS-REFUND, and no refund-execution tool exists in the tool surface to close out the 242 affected orders even if identified.
Gateway-config tool health is UNKNOWN at design time; readiness should be confirmed before set_capture_idempotency is ever executed.
Two open unknowns, U-LATENCY-REGRESSION-RISK and U-TICKET-METRIC-UNDERCOUNT, remain unresolved and their validation may extend past the available time window.
